summary: Federal contracts are let by full and open competition, with limited exceptions.
realLife: The Federal Acquisition Regulation says contracting officers must promote and provide for full and open competition in soliciting offers and awarding contracts, with certain limited exceptions.
sources: Acquisition.GOV, Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.101 Policy: https://www.acquisition.gov/far/6.101
